name: Occlusion-Aware vMF Importance Sampler
definition: A lightweight importance sampler using a Neural Graphics Primitive (NGP) to predict a mixture of von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distributions for incoming radiance at each point in space, capable of modeling occlusions by turning off lobes for occluded light sources.
summary: It is a lightweight importance sampler for volume rendering that uses a neural graphics primitive to predict spatially-varying von Mises-Fisher distributions, distinguishing itself by dynamically turning off lobes for occluded light sources.
